item.title: COCA Adds Cross-Chain Stablecoin Deposits Across 13 Networks
item.summary: COCA, a self-custodial banking application available across more than 75 countries, has integrated Aurora Intents to simplify stablecoin deposits across multiple blockchain networks. The integration, built by Aurora Labs and powered by NEAR Intents, allows users to deposit supported stablecoins from numerous networks into a single reusable COCA address without manually selecting the destination blockchain.
